scope: follow-up baseline audit after initial feasibility sweep; same synthetic observations regenerated from the recorded seed
baseline: weighted least-squares reward reconstruction on observed pair graph; optimize fixed-reference restricted policy value using reconstructed rewards
rank_feedback: not needed by this baseline; every method has the same recorded rating channel available
disconnected_graph: minimum-norm reward imputation with action 0 anchored; report disconnected fraction
policy_optimization: 2401-point parameter grid on [-12,12], then 35 golden-section refinements around best grid point
reproducibility_check: paired fusion-versus-binary sample means must reproduce the first sweep to 1e-10 before comparing reconstruction
claim_boundary: fully covered exact gaps make this straightforward baseline possible; it is existing reward estimation plus policy optimization, not a proposed new method
